list_trails.title: List trails
list_trails.description: List the account's trails with their delivery targets (OSS bucket, SLS project), event types and scope. Start here before changing a trail.

name_list.description: Comma-separated trail names to return; omit for all.

include_shadow_trails.description: Include multi-region trails created in other regions.

include_organization_trail.description: Include the resource directory's organization trail.

get_trail_status.title: Get a trail's status
get_trail_status.description: Check whether a trail is logging and when it last delivered events to OSS and SLS, with any delivery error.

is_organization_trail.description: The trail is the organization trail.

output.description: IsLogging, the latest delivery times and errors.

create_trail.title: Create a trail
create_trail.description: Create a trail that delivers events to an OSS bucket, an SLS project, or both. Logging does not start until start_logging is called.

oss_bucket_name.description: The OSS bucket to deliver to.

oss_key_prefix.description: A prefix for the delivered OSS objects.

oss_write_role_arn.description: The RAM role ARN ActionTrail assumes to write to OSS.

sls_project_arn.description: The SLS project ARN to deliver to, e.g. acs:log:cn-hangzhou:1234567890:project/trail-logs.

sls_write_role_arn.description: The RAM role ARN ActionTrail assumes to write to SLS.

trail_region.description: All to record every region, or one region ID.

is_organization_trail.description: Make this the organization trail for the resource directory.

update_trail.title: Update a trail
update_trail.description: Change a trail's delivery targets, roles, event type or region scope.

oss_write_role_arn.description: A new RAM role ARN for OSS writes.

sls_write_role_arn.description: A new RAM role ARN for SLS writes.

delete_trail.title: Delete a trail
delete_trail.description: Delete a trail. Delivery stops at once; events already in OSS or SLS stay where they are.

start_logging.title: Start a trail
start_logging.description: Start delivering events for a trail to its OSS bucket and SLS project.

stop_logging.title: Stop a trail
stop_logging.description: Stop delivering events for a trail. Events that occur while it is stopped are not delivered later, though lookup_events still covers the last 90 days.

lookup_events.title: Look up events
lookup_events.description: Search the last 90 days of management events: who did what, from where, against which resource. Filter by one attribute (for example EventName=DeleteInstance or ResourceName=i-bp1...) and a time window.

start_time.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 UTC.

attribute_value.description: The value the attribute must have.

next_token.description: The NextToken from the previous page.

direction.description: Page forwards (Forward, newest first) or backwards.

get_access_key_last_used_events.title: Last events by an AccessKey
get_access_key_last_used_events.description: List the most recent events an AccessKey made, to judge whether a key is still in use before disabling it.

next_token.description: The NextToken from the previous page.

get_access_key_last_used_products.title: Services an AccessKey used
get_access_key_last_used_products.description: List the cloud services an AccessKey has called and when each was last called.

get_access_key_last_used_ips.title: Source IPs of an AccessKey
get_access_key_last_used_ips.description: List the source IP addresses an AccessKey was used from for one service, to spot a leaked key.

output.description: The source IPs and last-used times.

get_access_key_last_used_resources.title: Resources an AccessKey touched
get_access_key_last_used_resources.description: List the resources an AccessKey acted on within one service.

create_delivery_history_job.title: Backfill a trail
create_delivery_history_job.description: Deliver the last 90 days of events to a trail's targets, for a trail created after the events happened. Only one job per trail at a time.

get_delivery_history_job.title: Get a backfill job
get_delivery_history_job.description: Read a historical-delivery job's status and per-region progress.

list_delivery_history_jobs.title: List backfill jobs
list_delivery_history_jobs.description: List historical-delivery jobs and their status.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

delete_delivery_history_job.title: Delete a backfill job
delete_delivery_history_job.description: Delete a finished or failed historical-delivery job record.

get_global_events_storage_region.title: Get the global events region
get_global_events_storage_region.description: Read which region stores events from global services such as RAM.

update_global_events_storage_region.title: Set the global events region
update_global_events_storage_region.description: Change which region stores events from global services.

list_regions.title: List regions
list_regions.description: List the regions ActionTrail serves and their endpoints.
